messages:
Hannah: quick prep thread for tomorrow's rehearsal (9:30 PT). need final run-of-show, two landing copy variants for the registration page (we'll A/B test), explicit stage-manager switch cmds, and the contingency video if demo flakes. pls react when youve read.

Hannah: run-of-show (global-ready):
- 0:00 welcome + objective (Hannah)
- 2:00 benchmark narrative: 2 bullets on cost vs latency (Diego)
- 6:00 demo: hosted -> dedicated failover + model variant switch (Leila)
- 15:00 audience Q&A + CTA -> HubSpot short form (Omar)
- 21:00 closing + next steps (Hannah)

Diego: benchmark slide will have a visual (cost per 1M tokens) + a single caveat line about quantization artifacts. I'll include a short link to the eval notebook and the "benchmark postcard" downloadable (leads get it).

Leila: demo plan notes: primary route = webinar-hosted (redwood/v1-small); fallback route = webinar-dedicated (redwood/v1-medium-quant). also we'll briefly switch to an ultra-low-cost quant variant to demonstrate throughput. Keep prompts max 25 tokens.

Omar: HubSpot mapping: hs_webinar_key = "mar_global_2026", hs_interest = ["hosting","dedicated","private"], hidden field model_demo_variant, hidden utm_campaign=webinar_mar_global. Also add hs_benchmark_download = true when they opt-in for the postcard. I'll build a workflow to tag leads and assign to sales queue regionally.

Hannah: two landing copy variants for reg page (vote A/B please):
A) "Serving for scale: practical tradeoffs between latency, cost, and reliability"
B) "Keep customer experiences fast and affordable: real serving choices that matter"

Diego: vote B (narrative hook better for CTR).

Omar: vote A (clear keywords for SEO).

Leila: I'll side with B. we can A/B test.

Hannah: B it is for the social/ads; we'll keep A for SEO fallback on the site. good.

Leila: stage manager commands (demo VM exports DEMO_TOKEN). copy/paste below. these are intentionally short so SM can run them in greenroom.

```
# failover to dedicated (preserves KV if compatible)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/routes/switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"webinar-route","target":"redwood/v1-medium-quant","meta":"demo_fallback"}'
```

```
# switch to ultra-low-cost quant (throughput demo)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/routes/switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"webinar-route","target":"redwood/v1-small-4bit","meta":"throughput_demo"}'
```

```
# reset to primary (hosted)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/routes/switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"webinar-route","target":"redwood/v1-small","meta":"demo_reset"}'
```

Hannah: contingency plan if live demo flakes: play the pre-recorded demo video (6:00 mark). Omar, make sure the HubSpot form still goes live even if we use the video. capture the "benchmark postcard" opt-in.

Omar: got it. I'll make the form public and add a fallback manual submit link. workflow will mark the lead source as "webinar_playback" if video used. also will tag region by IP detection and add to the right sales queue.

Diego: note for slides 




 small caveat: quantized variants may slightly shorten punctuation in edge cases. we'll avoid creative examples and use short factual Qs.

Leila: greenroom checklist:
- prewarm dedicated pool 8m prior (OpsBot)
- short-lived demo token limited to route-switch (Security)
- captions + recording start 9:25 PT (Prod)
- stage manager has copy of commands + short prompts list (Leila)
- pre-recorded video accessible as fallback (Omar)

OpsBot: prewarm scheduled for webinar-route dedicated pool at 2026-03-24T09:22:00Z (requested by Leila).

Omar: live chat coverage: Hannah will triage product and SLA questions, I will drop lead form links and postcard opt-in, Diego will handle technical bench follow-ups. I'll prepare canned replies for pricing, SLA, and "how to get Dedicated".

Hannah: final timing notes: greenroom 9:10 PT, captions on 9:25, rehearsal 9:30 sharp. final ask drop your 30s speaker intros in the rehearsal doc by EOD. see you all. :rocket:
